{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, stripping commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders that are NOT refunded
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check if any QA orders are in this group
qa_in_loyal_completed = (loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print evidence
print(f'Number of LOYAL customers with completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'QA orders in LOYAL completed group: {qa_in_loyal_completed}')
print(f'Mean revenue of LOYAL completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
